answer: Stop sybils at the inlet: each identity enters through one narrow inlet, a bonded slot sponsored by an established agent, admitting only a handful per epoch. Entry locks a copper bond into a jointly liable shared pool: if any member cheats, every bond in that inlet slashes at once, so N clones in one inlet lose N bonds for one offence, while spreading out needs a fresh sponsor per inlet. The nectar reward flows only through an inlet with a clean record; a poisoned inlet earns nothing. One honest agent pays one bond; a clone farm pays N bonds, N sponsors, and N-squared in correlated slash risk.
